title: An Idea, Connected. (Luxury Editorial, night refresh)

scenes.title: The idea ignites
scenes.purpose: Establish the quiet ink-navy stage and show a single idea (the amber hub) and a typed headline starting the system.
visuals: Stationary ink-navy field with a cool steel radial glow behind the diagram and a faint dot grid
Amber eyebrow 'MAISON · VOLUME XX' fades in
Amber hub appears; a lighter disc expands from it through a circular mask
'An Idea,' typed character by character behind an amber caret, which disappears when the line completes
Five spokes draw outward from the hub; each bone node appears only when its spoke reaches it

beats.development: Eyebrow and hub appear; the headline types out 'An Idea,' with a leading amber caret, and the disc of the system begins to expand.
The caret is gone, spokes reach their nodes and 'Connected.' begins its masked wipe.

scenes.title: The system closes
scenes.purpose: Complete the connected system and the editorial lockup, then hold everything settled for reading.
visuals: The steel-to-bone gradient ring draws clockwise from the top node; then the outer steel hairline frame draws
Amber rule grows from its left anchor; body copy and 'EST. MMXXVI' fade in
Tracked ring words appear on the inner right arc once the outer frame is complete
Slow camera push on the diagram and gentle counter-drift on the copy, both settling at 2.6 s

beats.development: Ring and outer frame close the system; the rule, body copy, EST line and ambient ring words complete the lockup in order.
captions: One thought, quietly drawn into an enduring system.

beats.development: Camera and ring rotation ease to rest by 2.6 s; the whole composition holds still and legible.

findings: Typing at 0.075 s per character fits the brief while keeping the luxury cadence measured.
Containers are drawn before their labels: the ring words appear only after the outer frame finishes at 1.8 s.
Everything is settled by 2.6 s, inside the 2.7 s legibility requirement.
justifiedHolds: 2.25–3.0 s: a still hold so the full headline, body copy and system diagram can be read together.

notes: Silent preview: no audio was created.
Palette refreshed from the source-frame review (ink-navy field, steel glow, bone type, amber accent). There is no approved task palette.
GSAP is the single motion owner; Motion is not used because its seek integration is unverified.
